episodes.title: Geheimnisse
episodes.summary: In 2019, a local boy's disappearance stokes fear in the residents of Winden, a small German town with a strange and tragic history.

episodes.title: Lügen
episodes.summary: When a grim discovery leaves the police baffled, Ulrich seeks a search warrant for the power plant. A mysterious stranger checks into the hotel.

episodes.title: Gestern und Heute
episodes.summary: It's 1986, and Ulrich's brother, Mads, has been missing for a month. Confusion reigns as past and present intertwine.

episodes.title: Doppelleben
episodes.summary: Bizarre occurrences give Charlotte a sense of déjà vu, and she suspects Peter is hiding something. Franziska snaps when Magnus confronts her.

episodes.title: Wahrheiten
episodes.summary: Hannah takes her obsession with Ulrich too far. The stranger asks Regina to deliver an important package. Martha is torn between Jonas and Bartosz.

episodes.title: Sic Mundus Creatus Est
episodes.summary: Ulrich looks to the past for answers and dredges up disturbing family secrets. Armed with new tools, Jonas probes the cave's murky depths.

episodes.title: Kreuzwege
episodes.summary: Ulrich questions a frail and frightened Helge in the nursing home. Jonas searches for Mikkel, but the stranger warns him about meddling with the past.

episodes.title: Was man sät, das wird man ernten
episodes.summary: In 1953, the disfigured bodies of two boys are exhumed at a construction site, the future location of Winden's nuclear power plant.

episodes.title: Alles ist jetzt
episodes.summary: Ulrich runs afoul of the law, Helge tries to dodge Egon Tiedemann, Claudia harnesses the cave's powers, and Katharina lashes out at Hannah.

episodes.title: Alpha und Omega
episodes.summary: Peter gets a shock. Jonas learns the truth about his family, but there are more surprises still to come. Helge makes a sacrifice.

episodes.title: Anfänge und Enden
episodes.summary: Six months after the disappearances, the police form a task force. In 2052, Jonas learns that most of Winden perished in an apocalyptic event.

episodes.title: Dunkle Materie
episodes.summary: Clausen and Charlotte interview Regina. The Stranger takes Hannah to 1987, where Claudia has an unnerving encounter and Egon visits an old nemesis.

episodes.title: Gespenster
episodes.summary: In 1954, a missing Helge returns, but he'll only speak to Noah. In 1987, Claudia brings the time machine to Tannhaus, and Egon questions Ulrich again.

episodes.title: Die Reisenden
episodes.summary: Jonas meets an ominous figure. While the kids comb the cave for answers, the adults gather in the bunker to share what they know about the travelers.

episodes.title: Vom Suchen und Finden
episodes.summary: In 1987, Ulrich seizes an opportunity. The kids return to the cave with the time machine, and Jonas learns of a loophole that could change the future.

episodes.title: Ein unendlicher Kreis
episodes.summary: Armed with a plan to prevent the apocalypse, Jonas travels to 2019. During the Nielsens' anniversary party, Ulrich sneaks off with Hannah.

episodes.title: Der weiße Teufel
episodes.summary: Martha meets the Stranger and learns his true identity. Claudia tries to prevent Egon's death in 1987. Hannah travels to 1954 to see Ulrich.

episodes.title: Enden und Anfänge
episodes.summary: On the day of the apocalypse, Clausen executes a search warrant at the power plant as Jonas and Claudia use the time machine to connect past and future.

episodes.title: Déjà-vu
episodes.summary: In 2019, Jonas emerges from the cave into a strange but familiar world: the town of Winden, reeling from the recent disappearance of a young boy.

episodes.title: Die Überlebende
episodes.summary: Martha travels to 1888 to warn her friends about the 2020 disaster. Winden residents past and present search for their missing loved ones.

episodes.title: Adam und Eva
episodes.summary: Charlotte and Ulrich try to piece together what happened in the bunker. In different times and worlds, Jonas and Martha work to gain each other's trust.

episodes.title: Der Ursprung
episodes.summary: Martha and Jonas travel to 2052 and get a glimpse of a grim future. In 1954, two residents of Winden go missing, and Hannah receives surprising news.

episodes.title: Leben und Tod
episodes.summary: In 2020, a visitor delivers a warning to Claudia. The day before the apocalypse, Jonas begins to question Eva's motives.

episodes.title: Licht und Schatten
episodes.summary: Adam holds Martha captive in 2020. On the day of the apocalypse, an increasingly frantic Martha begs Bartosz for his help.

episodes.title: Zwischen der Zeit
episodes.summary: Across three centuries, Winden's residents continue their desperate quest to alter their fate and save their loved ones.

episodes.title: Das Paradies
episodes.summary: Claudia reveals to Adam how everything is connected — and how he can destroy the knot.
